name: ShinobIDLE
storyline:
A blood-red moon has risen over the land of the shinobi. Bandits set fire to the shrine of the Lantern Forest, and its guardian spirit awoke in flames.

Guided by the master of their class, a lone ninja sets out from the burning forest toward the misty lakes, the windswept canyons, the thunder peaks and, at last, the Black Moon Citadel, facing the beasts, yokai and warlords that rule each land.
summary:
ShinobIDLE is an online idle RPG set in a pixel art world of shinobi, yokai and warlords. Your ninja walks and fights on its own inside a small strip on your desktop, clearing waves of monsters, defeating stage bosses and collecting chests while you work, study or do something else. Six classes, each with its own jutsu tree, travel across five maps of ten stages, and every map ends with a powerful boss that can only be challenged with an access key.

Beyond the solo journey, every item that drops from monsters can be traded with other players in a player-driven market. Players also join clans that face a weekly dungeon and battle each month for control of a castle, and they test their builds in real-time 1v1 ranked arena duels.
